correctness.rationale: Equation (1) follows exactly by expanding fourth powers of the two repeated gradient steps. Two elementary spectral endpoint moment bounds and Jensen bound reduce the all-dimensional case to a cubic plus a strictly negative discriminant-controlled case. The exact cubic discriminant and reciprocal-quartic transformation establish if-and-only-if kappa <= kappa-star, equality at the boundary, and open-set violation above. Exact Fraction and SymPy script executed from packaged actual file path and returned VERIFY_OK and rational ratio >1. This is an analytic proof, not finite experimental inference.

value.rationale: A mathematically motivated, sharp and computable universal safety boundary answers a natural unanswered finite-cycle question for a recently studied nonmonotone algorithm. The moment reduction classifies all dimensions, the exact threshold is not an arbitrary slice, and two-dimensional open-set counterexamples beyond it establish an unavoidable loss of objective safety. It is independent of and complements convergence rates without claiming a larger downstream theorem.
